client_checkins_measurements_non_negativ.name: client_checkins_measurements_non_negative
client_checkins_measurements_non_negativ.value:
("client_checkins"."waist_mm" is null or "client_checkins"."waist_mm" >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."hips_mm"  is null or "client_checkins"."hips_mm"  >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."chest_mm" is null or "client_checkins"."chest_mm" >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."arm_mm"   is null or "client_checkins"."arm_mm"   >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."thigh_mm" is null or "client_checkins"."thigh_mm" >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."neck_mm"  is null or "client_checkins"."neck_mm"  >= 0)

invoices_pdf_r2_fields_together.name: invoices_pdf_r2_fields_together
invoices_pdf_r2_fields_together.value: ("invoices"."pdf_r2_bucket" is null and "invoices"."pdf_r2_object_key" is null) or ("invoices"."pdf_r2_bucket" is not null and "invoices"."pdf_r2_object_key" is not null)

invoices_dates_valid.name: invoices_dates_valid
invoices_dates_valid.value: "invoices"."due_date" is null or "invoices"."issue_date" is null or "invoices"."due_date" >= "invoices"."issue_date"
